schema: Ground truth = events already attributed (or explicitly called unattributed) in docs/RESUME.md and docs/run-log-2026-10.md. Nothing here was labelled by hand from the fixture data; windows come from the quoted doc text, or (build drops) from the watchdog file the doc names.
scope_rule: The detector is growth-only. An event where a move or deletion FREES space (kind=shrink) is out of scope for detection and is listed as not evaluable. Growth events are evaluable only when the fixtures hold a sample of the event's volume within 1 h of both ends of its window (and, for an attributed key, a series of the fixture_key).
match_rule: An alert episode on the event's volume whose first alert falls in [start, end + 6 h] detects the event. Attribution is correct when the first such alert names fixture_key or a folder below it; naming an ancestor is reported as coarse, not correct.

events.evaluable_reason: shrink: a move frees space, the growth-only detector has nothing to detect
